content:
In reply to https://hacdias.com/notes/2020/04/08/3/context-boxes/.

Definitely useful! (I’m also still searching for a better way to display such context, and for now tend to explicitly mention the URL I’m referring to do, and maybe a blockquote. Minimal, but works.)

I still mostly follow blogs via RSS, however, and items in quite a few feeds out there (including yours, it seems) don’t show much context at all, which honestly can be a bit confusing.
